name: "A Minecraft Server"
description: Welcome to Runic Hearth SMP, a free survival server where Java and Bedrock players can build, explore, and play together. We’re starting a new community, come claim your spot and make it home. Protect your builds with land claims, set up to three homes, teleport to friends, and level up your skills with mcMMO. PvP is disabled so you can focus on your next adventure. Our server has 8GB of ram and will be taken down any time we need to increase the ram to hold additional players. What’s included: Java + Bedrock crossplay, Land claims to protect your homeThree homes and teleport requests, Economy with player-to-player payments, mcMMO, skills and progression. Optional proximity voice chat for Java players 30 player slots. Type /welcome for the command guide and /kit claim to get your claiming tools. Operated by Runic Hosting. Playing is free—no hosting purchase required. Java: play.runichosting.com Bedrock: play.runichosting.com — port 25566
